landing.hero_badge: How good is your English, really?
landing.hero_title_part1: Discover what you can already do.
landing.hero_desc: Discover your strengths and understand what's holding you back without memorizing everything from scratch. Assess in 3 minutes through real-life everyday situations—no upfront sign-up required.
landing.calm_ritual_desc: A peaceful, pressure-free personal practice space built for sustainable long-term progress.
landing.quick_check_desc: Respond to 8 everyday situations to get your Personal English Snapshot instantly without any guilt-inducing tests.
landing.shift_title: Why English Used to Feel Difficult
landing.shift_desc: Shift from exhausting grammar drills to natural, actionable language acquisition.
landing.old_way_item1: Memorizing grammar tables and rules without knowing how to speak naturally
landing.old_way_item2: Reviewing hundreds of flashcards but forgetting real context when writing
landing.old_way_item3: Constant anxiety about making mistakes preventing actual conversation
landing.glova_way_item1: Visualize sentence mechanics through intuitive animated timelines
landing.glova_way_item2: Acquire vocabulary with authentic phonetics and sentence stress
landing.glova_way_item3: Private, safe speaking and writing studios with precise feedback
landing.studios_desc: Every skill develops as a connected system aligned with international CEFR A1 to C2 standards.
landing.studio_vocab_desc: Master words with phonetic symbols, syllable stress, and authentic usage examples rather than isolated definitions.
landing.studio_grammar_desc: Animated timelines illustrate tenses and linguistic structures intuitively without rote formulas.
landing.studio_reading_desc: Contemporary short essays with comfortable typography to build natural comprehension without translating every word.
landing.studio_listening_desc: Adjustable-speed audio player with visual waveforms to help you capture core meanings in natural speech.
landing.studio_writing_desc: A distraction-free essay and email drafting space with live word counters and structural guidance.
landing.studio_speaking_desc: Record simulated conversations in a safe, judgment-free environment to build real confidence.
landing.habit_desc: You do not need to study for hours. Just 5 to 10 minutes at your convenience builds fluency that lasts a lifetime.
landing.cambridge_desc: Standardized exam formats and vocabulary syllabi structured along the CEFR framework from A1 to C2.
landing.cambridge_trust: Skill progression exercises aligned with international CEFR criteria
landing.final_cta_title: An English Journey Built for You
landing.final_cta_desc: Take your first step today with no credit card required. Complete a quick diagnostic to find your ideal starting point.
